fair sharing can create incentives for co-opition and the importance of such incentives depends on the structure of the network.

the development of the fair sharing scheme for IOSs and the analysis of the impact of the network structure on the incentives of competitors to participate in such schemes.
the problem of IOS adoption in the context of co-opetition and uneven distribution of the benefits.

fair sharing is a promising approach to address issues of co-opetition and uneven distribution of the benefits among IOS users.
the use of fair sharing approach can help to overcome barriers for IOS adoption and can boost co-opetition in inter-organizational networks.

fair sharing approach can help to overcome the barrier of uneven distribution of benefits and thus to boost the adoption of IOSs in the modern business environment.

the IOS adoption is more likely to be successful if the community members are able to coordinate their actions in a way that allows them to reap the benefits of co-opetition.
